planSteps.description: Navigate to https://soncagstock.vercel.app/ and log in with the project's configured username and password (click 'Giriş Yap'), wait until the header text 'Sonçağ Stok · Dashboard' is visible
Read the total N from the pagination text '<N> üründen ... gösteriliyor', then open the category select 'Tüm Kategoriler', note the second option's text, select it and wait 2 seconds
The products table shows at least 1 row and every visible row's 'Kategori' cell text equals the selected category name
The pagination text now shows a total that is smaller than or equal to the N read before filtering
